acceptance: LakeSail's default container limit is evidenced at the largest gated scale or removed.
CI and the default agree, or the owner approved the difference.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Before #4340 LakeSail had no memory limit under Docker. #4340 adds a 4g default in docker/lakesail/docker-compose.yml for every engine and describes it as a limit mocker previously ignored. trunk-uat.yml and release-v2.yml set LAKESAIL_MEMORY_LIMIT to 12g, so CI certifies 12g while users get 4g, and nothing tests 4g at SF 1. The 12g shard has never run (the probe dispatch fails with HTTP 403). The tracker guardrail on the LakeSail item says never to silently change UAT container limits.

## Change
Run LakeSail TPC-DS-OBT at SF 1 with the 4g default through `make uat-cell` or `make heavy-run` and record peak memory and outcome. Then either keep 4g with that evidence and make CI test the same value, or remove the new default. Correct the changelog and spec wording to say a limit was added.

## Decision gates
The owner chooses keep-4g-with-evidence, another value, or no default, after seeing the SF 1 result. CI and the user default must not differ without a stated reason the owner accepts.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the SF 1 run's bundle, mem trace and command are recorded; the compose default, both workflows, the provisioning table and the changelog state the same facts; a stage-2 CI run with the chosen value is linked or its absence is stated.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
